name: unsafe fn set_len (& mut self , new_len : usize)
rule: When calling `Vec::set_len`, the elements in `old_len..new_len` must be initialized, where `old_len` is the vector's length before the call.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::vec::Vec < T , A > { unsafe fn set_len (& mut self , new_len : usize) }
expression: Not expressible in the supplied DSL: it has no way to select or quantify over the pointee elements in `old_len..new_len`.
